UseSquirtbottleText:
It's a weird tree.
Use SQUIRTBOTTLE?
SudowoodoAttackedText:
The weird tree
doesn't like the SQUIRTBOTTLE!

The weird tree
attacked!
FloriaText1:
I'm the FLOWER
SHOP's FLORIA!

Listen, listen!

When I sprinkled
water on that

wiggly tree, it
jumped right up!

It just has to be
a #MON.

I bet it would be
shocked out of its

disguise if you
soaked it!

I know! I'll tell
my sis and borrow her water bottle!
FloriaText2:
When I told my sis
about the jiggly

tree, she said
it's dangerous.

If I beat WHITNEY,
I wonder if she'll

lend me her water
bottle…
RockSmashGuyText1:
Wa-hey!

I was going to
snap that tree

with my straight-
arm punch.

But I couldn't!
I'm a failure!
RockSmashGuyText2:
Did you clear that
wretched tree?

I'm impressed!
I want you to have this.
RockSmashGuyText3:
That happens to be
ROCK SMASH.

You can shatter
rocks with just a

single well-aimed
smack.

If any rocks are
in your way, just smash 'em up!
UnusedOddTreeText:
An odd tree is
blocking the way to GOLDENROD CITY.

I wanted to go see
the huge #MON

CENTER they just
opened…
Route36LassText:
An odd tree is
blocking the way to GOLDENROD CITY.

It's preventing
me from shopping.

Something should
be done about it.
Route36LassText_ClearedSudowoodo:
That odd tree dis-
appeared without a trace.

Oh! That tree was
really a #MON?
PsychicMarkSeenText:
I'm going to read
your thoughts!
PsychicMarkAfterBattleText:
I'd be strong if
only I could tell

what my opponent
was thinking.
SchoolboyAlan1SeenText:
Thanks to my stud-
ies, I'm ready for any #MON!
SchoolboyAlanBooksText:
Darn. I study five
hours a day too.

There's more to
learning than just reading books.
MeetArthurText:
ARTHUR: Who are
you?

I'm ARTHUR of
Thursday.
ArthurGaveGiftText:
ARTHUR: A #MON
that uses rock-

type moves should
hold on to that.

It pumps up rock-
type attacks.
ArthurThursdayText:
ARTHUR: I'm ARTHUR
of Thursday. I'm

the second son out
of seven children.
ArthurNotThursdayText:
ARTHUR: Today's
not Thursday. How disappointing.
Route36TrainerTips1Text:
TRAINER TIPS

#MON stats
vary--even within the same species.

Their stats may be
similar at first.

However, differ-
ences will become

pronounced as the
#MON grow.
Route36TrainerTips2Text:
TRAINER TIPS

Use DIG to return
to the entrance of any place.

It is convenient
for exploring

caves and other
landmarks.
